title.zh: 在马尼拉设立菲律宾群岛人种学、自然史与商业博物馆，并为此拨付八千美元（美金）以维持其运作及支付采集、保管与保存菲律宾群岛人种学实物所需费用的法案
title.en: AN ACT ESTABLISHING IN MANILA AN INSULAR MUSEUM OF ETHNOLOGY, NATURAL HISTORY, AND COMMERCE, AND APPROPRIATING EIGHT THOUSAND DOLLARS, IN MONEY OF THE UNITED STATES, FOR MAINTAINING THE SAME AND FOR PAYING THE EXPENSES OF COLLECTING, CARING FOR, AND PRESERVING THE OBJECTS ILLUSTRATING THE ETHNOLOGY OF THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS.
title.orig: AN ACT ESTABLISHING IN MANILA AN INSULAR MUSEUM OF ETHNOLOGY, NATURAL HISTORY, AND COMMERCE, AND APPROPRIATING EIGHT THOUSAND DOLLARS, IN MONEY OF THE UNITED STATES, FOR MAINTAINING THE SAME AND FOR PAYING THE EXPENSES OF COLLECTING, CARING FOR, AND PRESERVING THE OBJECTS ILLUSTRATING THE ETHNOLOGY OF THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS.
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Bảo tàng Đảo thuộc về Dân tộc học, Lịch sử Tự nhiên và Thương mại tại Manila và cấp 8.000 đô la Mỹ để duy trì bảo tàng này và chi trả chi phí sưu tầm, bảo quản và gìn giữ các hiện vật minh họa dân tộc học quần đảo Philippines
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งพิพิธภัณฑ์เกาะด้านมานุษยวิทยาประวัติศาสตร์ธรรมชาติและพาณิชย์ที่มะนิลาและจัดสรรงบประมาณแปดพันดอลลาร์สหรัฐอเมริกาเพื่อดำเนินการรักษาพิพิธภัณฑ์นี้และชำระค่าใช้จ่ายในการเก็บรวบรวมดูแลและอนุรักษ์สิ่งของที่แสดงมานุษยวิทยาของหมู่เกาะฟิลิปปินส์
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Museum Kepulauan tentang Etnologi, Sejarah Alam, dan Perdagangan di Manila dan mengalokasikan delapan ribu dolar Amerika Serikat untuk memelihara museum tersebut serta membayar biaya pengumpulan, perawatan, dan pelestarian benda-benda yang mengilustrasikan etnologi Kepulauan Filipina
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Muzium Kepulauan antara Etnologi Sejarah Semula Jadi dan Perdagangan di Manila dan menyediakan lapan ribu dolar Amerika Syarikat untuk mengekalkan muzium ini dan membayar perbelanjaan mengumpul menjaga dan memelihara objek yang menggambarkan etnologi Kepulauan Filipina

text.en:
There is hereby established in Manila, under the Department of Public Instruction, an Insular
Museum of Ethnology, Natural History, and Commerce, and the same is hereby placed, temporarily, under
the immediate direction of the Chief of the Bureau of Non-Christian Tribes.

The sum of eight thousand dollars, in money of the United States, is hereby appropriated, out of
any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for paying the expenses of collecting objects
illustrating the ethnology, natural history, and commerce of the Philippine Islands, for caring for and
preserving these objects, and for meeting the necessary expenses involved in maintaining the Museum of
Ethnology, Natural History, and Commerce established by this Act.

The disbursing officer of the funds provided under this Act is hereby authorized to advance to the
Chief of the Bureau of Non-Christian Tribes, upon his request, from time to time, such bums out of this
appropriation as he may find necessary for the purchases, either personally or through agents by him
designated for that purpose, and for the collecting of objects by this Act authorized to be purchased or
collected, all such expenditures to be properly accounted for in accordance with law.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 29, 1901.
